findings.title: Verified AWS secret in deploy/terraform.tfvars:14
findings.description: trufflehog found a verified AWS credential in deploy/terraform.tfvars:14 (commit 0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f901234567) of https://github.com/example/app. The secret value is not stored; its hash prefix is sha256:691c8930e9c9.
findings.remediation: Revoke or rotate the AWS credential now: trufflehog confirmed it is live. Then remove it from the history (rotation is what makes it safe; history rewrites do not reach clones) and load it from a secret manager.

findings.title: Unverified PrivateKey secret in /srv/example/.env:3
findings.description: trufflehog found an unverified PrivateKey credential in /srv/example/.env:3 of test:scope. The secret value is not stored; its hash prefix is sha256:4f62b2cbc908.
findings.remediation: Check whether the value is a real PrivateKey credential. If it is, rotate it, remove it from the history and load it from a secret manager; if not, mark this finding as a false positive.
